objective: Resolve all CRITICAL issues from code review to reach production readiness. Three phases: (1) Security & Stability — secrets redaction, error isolation, crash recovery fix; (2) Data Integrity — persistent event store, history archive persistence, DLQ drain, optimistic concurrency; (3) Architecture Compliance — context budget enforcement, test runner timeout, idempotency fix, event type deduplication.

tickets.title: Implement Secrets Redaction in Context Engine
tickets.objective: Prevent .env files, credentials, and private keys from being sent to LLM via context builder or file read handler, enforcing ARCHITECTURE ch.46–47 token firewall policy.
acceptance_criteria: context-read-handler.js filters .env, *.key, *.pem, *.crt, *.pfx paths before reading
context-engine.js excludes sensitive paths during index record selection
agent-stream-bridge.js applies PII/redaction filter on stderr output
Unit tests verify secret patterns are blocked
Configuration-based exclusion list supported via config.secretsPatterns

tickets.title: Fix Event Store Persistence and Crash Recovery
tickets.objective: Make persistent-event-store the default event storage, add project_id to DDL and INSERT, return sequence numbers from SQLite AUTOINCREMENT, fix DB-vs-memory inconsistency race on insert.
acceptance_criteria: createEventStore() uses persistent variant by default
persistent-event-store DDL includes project_id column
INSERT statement stores project_id
stored event records include assigned sequence number from lastInsertRowid
In-memory insertion happens before DB write, or both wrapped in single transaction
event-publisher.js stops duplicating project_id into metadata object
assertEventRecord validates project_id presence

tickets.title: Implement Error Isolation in Event Subscription System
tickets.objective: Prevent a single subscription handler throw from killing the entire event delivery pipeline per ARCHITECTURE ch.40 agent protocol guarantees.
acceptance_criteria: subscription-registry.js wraps each handler call in try/catch
Errors are accumulated and reported without halting delivery to remaining subscribers
At least one failed handler does not affect other handlers
Error log includes subscription event_type pattern and handler reference
Optional: configurable max failures before disabling a subscription

tickets.title: Fix Database Write Transaction Wrapping and Startup Crash
tickets.objective: Eliminate partial writes in incremental-indexer.js, fix database.close() crash on watch-project.js startup failure.
acceptance_criteria: All multi-statement DB operations in incremental-indexer.js wrapped in BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK transactions
Parse errors update sha256 hash even when extraction fails (fix B4)
watch-project.js line 66 uses optional chaining: database?.close()
SQLite connection errors caught and logged before process exit
Unit tests verify transaction rollback on simulated DB failure

tickets.title: Implement History Archive Persistence and DLQ Drain Mechanism
tickets.objective: Persist archived history records to SQLite so they survive Node restart (arch ch.34), add dequeue/drain mechanism to dead-letter queue.
acceptance_criteria: history-store.js persists archive records to SQLite table
Archive compaction result counts only records compacted in current call
dead-letter-queue.js gains dequeue(id), drain(), purge(beforeTimestamp) methods
retry-policy.js routes exhausted retries to DLQ instead of throwing
Hot/warm/cold tiering tracks archival timestamps automatically

tickets.title: Add Optimistic Concurrency Control to Workflow State Machine
tickets.objective: Prevent concurrent workflow transitions from silently overwriting state (arch ch.51). Add version counter or ETag to state store for optimistic locking.
acceptance_criteria: workflow-transition-gate.js state objects carry _version field
writeState checks version matches before applying transition
Conflicting transitions detected and rejected with conflict error
File-based tmp+rename write remains atomic
State machine documentation clarifies state_before vs state_after semantics for denied vs pending_owner

tickets.title: Enforce Context Budget Limits in Context Engine
tickets.objective: Transform context budget from advisory-only to enforced limit (arch ch.49). Builder cap: 40k tokens, Reviewer cap: 30k tokens.
acceptance_criteria: context-engine.js compares estimated_tokens against budget.max_tokens
When budget exceeded: either truncate selection (smallest units first) or throw error with guidance
Token estimation documented as approximate (byte/4 heuristic)
Context Pack response includes actual_token_count vs limit
Index version check optimized to use single counter instead of full-table scan

tickets.title: Fix Idempotency Cache Race Condition and Static UUID Issue
tickets.objective: Fix command-idempotency.js cache race condition under error paths, replace static UUID defaults in sprint-leader-loop.js with proper random ID generation.
acceptance_criteria: command-idempotency.js holds cache entry until awaited result resolves or rejects (use in-flight sentinel)
Non-idempotent commands either removed from cache immediately or capped with TTL
IDEMPOTENT_COMMAND_TYPES expanded to include context.read_file and workflow.transition
sprint-leader-loop.js defaults to randomUUID()-based generators, not hardcoded strings
Idempotency unit tests cover race window scenario

tickets.title: Add Test Runner Timeout and Fix Sequential Verification Execution
tickets.objective: Add timeout parameter to verification pipeline (arch ch.44), change parallel test+check execution to sequential check-then-test ordering.
acceptance_criteria: verification/orchestrator.js runs check runners before test runners (not parallel)
command-executor.js accepts timeoutMs parameter
runner.js passes timeoutMs through to command executor
Timeout events emit proper TEST_TIMEOUT event and signal Builder (arch ch.44)
Default timeout configurable: build=60s, lint=30s, unit_test=120s, integration=300s

tickets.title: Consolidate Event Type Names and Fix Schema Inconsistencies
tickets.objective: Deduplicate event type names (agents.started vs agent.started), align envelope $ref paths with project convention, merge duplicated status enums across schemas.
acceptance_criteria: event.schema.json consolidates singular event types: agent.started, agent.failed, agent.completed
envelope.schema.json bare $refs replaced with ../core/common.schema.json#/$defs/... pattern
common.schema.json defines shared $defs/result_status and $defs/lifecycle_status referenced everywhere
error.schema.json gets title and description fields added
JSON Schema validator passes all consolidated schemas end-to-end

tickets.title: Fix Ajv missingRef result_status after T10 schema consolidation — register common.schema before compiling dependent schemas
tickets.objective: Fix regression from 10a5052 where shared $defs/result_status and $defs/lifecycle_status cause Ajv missingRef at startup, blocking EventStore/history persistence and making agent chat stuck at architecture.working.
acceptance_criteria: common.schema.json contains $defs/result_status and $defs/lifecycle_status as defined in T10, with $id https://forge.local/schemas/core/common.schema.json
Every Ajv instance that compiles envelope/event/verification/task schemas calls ajv.addSchema(commonSchema) BEFORE ajv.compile/addSchema of dependent schemas — no missingRef on startup
npm run validate:schemas passes 42 schemas / 63 fixtures without missingRef
Node Control API starts clean: tail .node-control/logs/node.log shows no Ajv missingRef stack, only 'Node Control API listening on http://127.0.0.1:3100'

After restart: POST /projects/:id/history returns items (not [] for project with prior events), and POST /projects/:id/conversations/:id/messages -> SSE receives architecture.message.delta then architecture.message.received instead of stuck working
Existing tests green: schema validation, lint, typecheck, git diff --check

tickets.title: Wrap ContextService with ContextEngine — buildContext() merges memory facts + indexed symbols via ContextBudgetManager
tickets.objective: Make agent context filesystem-aware: buildContext() must merge logical facts (memoryRetriever + taskSummaries + taskStore) with Code Index facts (ContextEngine), then enforce token budget via ContextBudgetManager. Preserves ARCHITECTURE.md invariants: token firewall, secrets redaction, .forge ignored, agent free to write.
acceptance_criteria: New wrapper createFilesystemAwareContextService({ baseContextService, contextEngine, budgetManager, database, projectRoot, projectId }) exists OR base createAgentContextService extended with optional contextEngine param

buildContext({ projectId, taskId, query, domain }) returns { projectFacts, taskFacts, currentTask, contextPack } where projectFacts = memoryFacts + indexFacts (symbols/files/dependencies mapped to fact strings)

Index facts sourced via contextEngine.build({ task_id, query, domain, include_dependencies: true }) — query/domain forwarded as symbol search; when query empty, skip index call and return logical facts only
Merged facts passed through budgetManager.selectFacts({ facts, maxFacts }) — budget enforced, not advisory
On ContextEngine error/empty index: fallback to logical facts only, no throw; error logged at debug level
Secrets paths (.env, *.key, *.pem, *.crt, *.pfx, *.keystore) filtered BEFORE merging — reuse secret patterns from NF-STAB-T01
Unit test: query='refreshSession' returns projectFacts containing 'symbol refreshSession in src/session.js' + memory facts, total capped by maxFacts
Unit test: empty query returns only memory facts, contextPack === null
Unit test: ContextEngine throws -> buildContext still returns logical facts, no crash
Integration: bootstrap wires the wrapper so agentRuntime.run() receives enriched context (verified by re-running node scripts/test-e2e-flow.mjs: 'ContextEngine -> Agent' moves from MISSING to WIRED)

tickets.title: Wire RuntimeService.startTask() -> AgentRuntime.run() — async agent execution with session sync return and event publishing
tickets.objective: Close the broken edge HTTP POST /tasks -> RuntimeService -> AgentRuntime: startTask() must persist session synchronously and return session snapshot immediately, then fire-and-forget agentRuntime.run({ projectId, taskId, query, domain }) asynchronously with proper agent.failed / agent.completed event publishing via publisher. Agent must receive filesystem-aware context from NF-STAB-T11 wrapper. Preserves ARCHITECTURE.md invariants: Node verification authoritative, watcher observes filesystem writes, no API proxy for file writes.
acceptance_criteria: runtime-service.js (or new src/application/agent-task-orchestrator.js) accepts injected agentRuntime and publisher in factory — createRuntimeService({ ..., agentRuntime, publisher }) or orchestrator wrapper; missing agentRuntime does not break existing unit tests (optional injection with no-op fallback)
startTask({ projectId, taskId, sessionId, query, domain }) still returns session snapshot synchronously — HTTP 201 response unchanged, no await on agent execution

After sessionStore.save(), calls agentRuntime.run({ projectId, taskId, query, domain }) asynchronously (fire-and-forget) — not awaited, errors caught and published as publisher.publish({ type: 'agent.failed', project_id, task_id, session_id, error })
On agent success publishes publisher.publish({ type: 'agent.completed', project_id, task_id, session_id, result }) — both paths increment eventsPublished and are observable via EventStore
Uses filesystem-aware contextService from NF-STAB-T11 — contextService.buildContext receives query/domain forwarded from startTask args
Duplicate startTask with same sessionId still throws 'Session already exists' before agent launch — idempotency preserved
No unhandled rejection leaks to HTTP handler — agent promise has .catch() that logs via logger and publishes failed event
Unit test: mock agentRuntime.run resolves -> startTask returns session immediately, publisher receives agent.completed after tick
Unit test: mock agentRuntime.run rejects -> startTask still returns session, publisher receives agent.failed, HTTP does not 500
Integration: POST /tasks triggers agent that writes src/e2e-smoke.txt -> watcher emits watcher.file_created -> verifiable via eventStore.getAll() + file exists on disk
Re-running node scripts/test-e2e-flow.mjs shows 'RuntimeService -> AgentRuntime' moves from MISSING to WIRED

tickets.title: Wire Bootstrap Composition Root — Assemble filesystem-aware AgentRuntime and close watcher -> verification -> SSE event loop
tickets.objective: Assemble the full dependency graph in bootstrap/index.js (or scripts/start-control-api.mjs): create ContextEngine, filesystem-aware ContextService (T11), AgentRuntime, VerificationOrchestrator, inject AgentRuntime into RuntimeService (T12), and wire internalBus watcher file events -> indexer done -> verification run -> publish verification.result -> SSE/dashboard fan-out. Preserves ARCHITECTURE.md invariants: token firewall, secrets redaction by T01, .forge ignored, agent direct filesystem write, Node authoritative verification.
acceptance_criteria: bootstrap/start-control-api creates in order: chokidar rawWatcher -> DebouncedWatcher -> IncrementalIndexer (indexDb, projectRoot) -> ContextEngine (database, projectRoot, projectId) -> base ContextService (memoryRetriever, taskSummaries, taskStore) -> filesystem-aware wrapper (T11) with budgetManager -> AgentRuntime (contextService, budgetManager, planningEngine, publisher, summaries, memory) -> VerificationOrchestrator (projectRoot, projectId) -> RuntimeService injected with agentRuntime and publisher (T12) — shared internalBus, database, projectId, projectRoot throughout
Production path uses real AgentRuntime, no mock/no-op fallback; test path still works when agentRuntime omitted (optional injection preserved) — existing runtime-service unit tests remain green

internalBus listener: on watcher.file_created / file_modified / file_deleted / file_renamed -> wait indexer.handle() completion -> trigger verificationOrchestrator.run() with minimal plan (one test check initially, 3-tier pipeline later) -> publish verification.result to EventStore/internalBus

SSE stream (conversationStream) and dashboard/projectDashboardService subscribe to verification.result and agent.* events (agent.completed / agent.failed) so UI updates in real time; no event dropped when publisher missing

Startup respects forge-layout.js: ensures .forge/runtime/index.db and ignores .forge/**, node_modules/**, .git/**, dist/**, coverage/** via watcher DEFAULT_WATCHER_IGNORE + debounced-watcher validation
Secrets filtering (T01) and context budget enforcement (T07) active on the merged context path — verification via contextService.buildContext before agent run

Re-running node scripts/test-e2e-flow.mjs shows WIRED for: RuntimeService -> AgentRuntime, ContextEngine -> Agent, Indexer -> Verification, Verification -> UI; section 8 import probe still all green
No circular dependency or double-publish: runtime recovery/replay (bootstrap recovery + replayEngine) still runs once at startup before wiring verification listener

tickets.title: Wire Watcher/Indexer/Verification -> SSE fan-out — close filesystem -> verification -> UI event loop
tickets.objective: Complete the remaining 40% of T13 by wiring DebouncedWatcher, IncrementalIndexer, and VerificationOrchestrator in the control API composition root (scripts/start-control-api.mjs / src/bootstrap/index.js) and connecting internalBus watcher file events -> indexer completion -> verification run -> publish verification.result -> SSE/dashboard fan-out. Preserves ARCHITECTURE.md invariants: watcher observes direct filesystem writes, .forge ignored, Node authoritative verification, token firewall via T01/T07.

verification.result published to EventStore/internalBus and fanned out to conversationStream SSE (GET /projects/:projectId/conversations/:conversationId/stream) and projectDashboardService dashboard (GET /projects/:projectId/dashboard), observable via GET /projects/:projectId/history
Startup respects src/infrastructure/filesystem/forge-layout.js: ensures .forge/runtime/index.db exists before watcher/indexer start; no watcher event emitted for .forge/** writes
Secrets filtering (T01) and context budget enforcement (T07) remain active on the context path feeding verification — no .env/*.key/*.pem content reaches verification payload

Smoke test without mocks: POST /tasks { projectId:"PROJECT-114A", taskId:"TASK-E2E-SMOKE-2", query:"create src/e2e-smoke2.txt" } OR direct fs write src/e2e-smoke2.txt -> watcher emits watcher.file_created -> indexer indexes -> verifier runs -> verification.result visible via GET /history and SSE stream

Existing tests remain green: node --test src/application/runtime-service.test.js, T11 context tests, lint, typecheck, git diff --check

tickets.title: Create queued DatabaseService for SQLite writes — single writer with ordered queue
tickets.objective: Replace direct openIndexDatabase concurrent writes from Node Control API and Filesystem/Index Watcher with a single DatabaseService that queues all SQLite writes in order with BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, eliminating UNIQUE constraint failed: files.path and database access denied errors. Reads remain parallel via WAL.
acceptance_criteria: Create src/infrastructure/sqlite/database-service.js exposing createDatabaseService({ dataDir, busyTimeoutMs, journalMode }) with methods write(sql, params), read(sql, params), transaction(fn), close() — write queue is FIFO with BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> COMMIT/ROLLBACK, busy_timeout and journal_mode=WAL set on open

Refactor eventStore, historyStore, sessionStore, roadmapStore, sprintPlanProjection, ticketProvenanceTracker, incrementalIndexer, indexMetadata to accept databaseService instead of raw database, and use service.write/read; no direct openIndexDatabase write outside service

Writes from Node server (agent profiles, secrets metadata, communication/history, event store, sessions, roadmap) and Watcher (files, symbols, imports/exports, calls/dependency edges, index metadata, watcher/verification events) all go through service queue; concurrent writes no longer cause UNIQUE constraint failed: files.path
Duplicate file path handled via INSERT OR REPLACE / ON CONFLICT upsert in service layer, verified by concurrent write test
Service survives restart: after npm run dev:forge:stop/start, GET /projects/PROJECT-114A/history still shows events and database not locked
